transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I publish the final staffing roster for the coordination cell during the upcoming four-day field exercise, we need to run our routine pre-exercise qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff. We've got three desks to fill — partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control — and each desk must be staffed by someone with the applicable current qualification. Our available personnel are Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega. I'd like to start by confirming each individual's current qualifications so we can match them to the right desks. Who can walk me through what each of these three is currently qualified for?
